title: Escalation Backstop Decision Tree for Top Account Roadmap Requests
creator: Ava Martinez
summary: Create a deterministic, auditable decision tree and backstop process for escalated feature requests from strategic (top-tier) accounts. The goal is to reduce ad-hoc PM/eng triage, provide predictable SLAs, capture revenue/contract constraints, and ensure high-touch requests are either accepted with clear commitments or routed to a defined follow-up cadence.
scope: Provide a scoring + decision tree that runs on intake form data and account signals. Deliverables: intake form update, automated scoring rules, human-review gates for high-risk/high-revenue cases, playbook for timeline commitments and communication templates, and a dashboard for triage SLAs and outstanding escalations.
acceptance_criteria: Intake form includes required fields: customer tier, ARR impact estimate, blocker vs enhancement flag, compliance/regulatory constraint, requested timeline, and legal/contract notes.
Automated scoring engine implemented in Airtable/Sheet with documented weights and a sample of 25 historical requests scored for calibration.
Decision tree documented with terminal actions: Accept (commit to roadmap), Schedule (planned work with timeline), Decline (with rationale + alternative), and Escalate to Exec Review.
SLA tracker dashboard shows median time to first response for escalations and percent resolved within defined windows (24h, 7d, 30d).
Communication templates (first response, scope confirmation, compensation negotiation, escalation briefing) stored in Confluence and available to CS/AM/PM teams.
tradeoffs: Conservative thresholds (low false negatives) reduce engineering noise but add manual review volume from PMs and AMs.
Aggressive acceptance criteria speed customer delight for a few accounts but risks roadmap churn and unmet OKRs.
Automating too many decisions risks missing nuance for regulatory or security-sensitive requests and requires human override paths.
Implementing full automation in Q1 will be lighter in accuracy; iterative calibration with historical data is planned.
Tying commits to contractual SLAs requires legal sign-off and may increase delivery overhead; we propose conditional commitment templates instead.
updates: 2026-02-26: Kickoff meeting with CS/SE/Legal. Agreed on core intake fields and that ARR threshold will be used as first-class signal.
2026-03-02: Draft scoring weights completed. Initial calibration on 30 historical escalations shows 78% recall for previously prioritized items (notes in Confluence).

2026-03-04: Engineering reviewed and requested removal of 'requested timeline' as a hard-trigger due to ambiguity; changed to scoring factor. Engineering prefers manual gate for any request requiring infra changes.
2026-03-06: Legal reviewed commitment language. Suggested conditional commitment template to avoid contractual exposure. Added to runbook links.
2026-03-09: CS requested a 'compensation options' flow for paid accelerations; added a branch in decision tree to surface pricing guidance and product/finance handoff.
2026-03-11: Built initial Airtable prototype and connected to a test Looker dashboard. Added sample fixture of 25 escalations for calibration. Next: UX copy for intake form and pilot with three AMs.

2026-03-12: Product review with Head of Engineering. Engineering proposed a soft-fallback policy to route overflow to Dedicated pre-sales for commit requests; agreed to document but not automate in v1.
open_questions: What exact ARR threshold(s) map to 'Exec Review' vs 'PM Review'? Suggested buckets: <$50k, $50k-250k, >$250k. Need revenue ops input.
How should we treat security/regulatory blockers from Private deployments (air-gapped/on-prem)? Propose automatic human gate.
Should we allow AMs to mark ' expedited' that bypasses weighting (manual override)? Need guardrails to prevent abuse.
What SLAs are reasonable for first substantive response (24h vs 48h) across regions?
next_steps: Finalize scoring buckets with Revenue Ops by 2026-03-18.
Create intake form copy + embed in CS toolkit; pilot sign-ups from 3 AMs by 2026-03-22.
Iterate scoring calibration after pilot (target precision > 85% for commits) and update Confluence.
Implement communication templates in Intercom/Shared Drive and train CS team (training session 2026-03-25).
Prepare rollout memo for Execs and schedule governance review for contractual language with Legal.
